data.action: 托腮看着蛋糕两眼放光
data.description: 【艾雅法拉 · 宿舍茶点】温馨可爱的宿舍小圆桌前，艾雅法拉双手托腮，看着面前刚出炉的草莓奶油小蛋糕两眼放光，羊角在头顶欢快地晃动——「哇！前辈特意为我带了蛋糕吗？因为听力不太好，平时总让前辈费心大声说话……真的太谢谢前辈了！」
data.promptProse: At the dorm's small round table, Eyjafjalla cups both cheeks and stares delightedly at strawberry cream cake, fleece hood and sheep pajamas retaining her cream-and-tan lounge outfit. Two tea cups steam beside the plate beneath her cheerful expression. The medium close-up includes the tabletop and tidy room behind. Bright afternoon light illuminates frosting and her eyes, casting soft cup shadows and gently catching steam above the cake without hiding the food.
data.title: 艾雅法拉 · 宿舍茶点
